<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<sbml xmlns="http://www.sbml.org/sbml/level3/version2/core" level="3" version="2">
  <model id="synthetic_ode_model" name="synthetic_ode_model" timeUnits="minute">
    <listOfUnitDefinitions>
      <unitDefinition id="minute">
        <listOfUnits>
          <unit kind="second" exponent="1" scale="0" multiplier="60"/>
        </listOfUnits>
      </unitDefinition>
    </listOfUnitDefinitions>
    <listOfCompartments>
      <compartment id="C" spatialDimensions="0" size="1" units="dimensionless" constant="true"/>
    </listOfCompartments>
    <listOfParameters>
      <parameter id="s" value="1" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="K" value="1" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="dr" value="0.4" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="kp" value="0.7" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="dp" value="0.3" constant="true"/>
      <parameter id="R" value="0.2" units="dimensionless" constant="false"/>
      <parameter id="P" value="0.1" units="dimensionless" constant="false"/>
    </listOfParameters>
    <listOfRules>
      <rateRule variable="R">
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
          <apply>
            <minus/>
            <apply>
              <divide/>
              <ci> s </ci>
              <apply>
                <plus/>
                <cn type="integer"> 1 </cn>
                <apply>
                  <power/>
                  <apply>
                    <divide/>
                    <ci> P </ci>
                    <ci> K </ci>
                  </apply>
                  <cn type="integer"> 2 </cn>
                </apply>
              </apply>
            </apply>
            <apply>
              <times/>
              <ci> dr </ci>
              <ci> R </ci>
            </apply>
          </apply>
        </math>
      </rateRule>
      <rateRule variable="P">
        <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML">
          <apply>
            <minus/>
            <apply>
              <times/>
              <ci> kp </ci>
              <ci> R </ci>
            </apply>
            <apply>
              <times/>
              <ci> dp </ci>
              <ci> P </ci>
            </apply>
          </apply>
        </math>
      </rateRule>
    </listOfRules>
  </model>
</sbml>
